name: dogfood-mysql-rls-tenant-app
description: Dogfood app (v1.26-3) — a Nuxt 3 + Prisma + MySQL 8 multi-tenant SaaS with row-level security policies, automatic tenant_id injection, cross-tenant refuse, bypass_rls audit trail, and a testcontainers-driven fidelity harness. Exercises 4 patterns (tenant_id auto-injection on write / cross-tenant read refuse under policy / bypass_rls role guard with audit log / tamper-evident audit log across the 3 ops) driven by @kiwa-test/orm's RLS semantics in KIWA_MODE=mock and testcontainers MySQL 8 in KIWA_MODE=real (env-skip MYSQL_KEY). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/orm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
